description: Runs read-only shadow reviewers alongside the main Codex agent: a heartbeat after edits dispatches them in the background, and an end-of-turn gate replays anything they found. The PostToolUse matcher lists tool names across Codex versions: 0.147 routes nearly everything through a single `exec` tool whose JS payload calls `tools.exec_command(...)`, while older builds exposed `exec_command` and `apply_patch` as tool names in their own right. Matching only the latter makes the heartbeat never fire on current Codex.
